text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Admin time dropped fast.** Reps reclaimed roughly five hours a week once they stopped typing up call notes after visits.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete, so handoffs between reps and account managers got easier.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Telling them upfront, and offering to pause recording, turned most concerns into non-issues.

**4. Summaries need a human glance.** The tool occasionally missed nuance on pricing and next steps. A quick two-minute review fixed it.

**5. Adoption followed leadership.** Teams used it more when managers referenced the notes in pipeline reviews.

The tool didn't make anyone a better seller. It gave them time to be one.

What has your team learned from AI pilots?
